changeChair(address).notice: Set the chair of the fed. Only callable by governance.

changeGov(address).notice: Change the governance of the Fed contact. Only callable by governance.

changeMarketCeiling(address,uint256).notice: Set a market's isolated ceiling of the Fed. Only callable by governance.

changeSupplyCeiling(uint256).notice: Set the supply ceiling of the Fed. Only callable by governance.

contraction(address,uint256).notice: Contract the amount of DOLA by withdrawing some amount of DOLA from a market, before burning it.

expansion(address,uint256).notice: Expand the amount of DOLA by depositing the amount into a specific market.

getProfit(address).notice: Gets the profit of a market.

resign().notice: Set the address of the chair to the 0 address. Only callable by the chair.

userdoc.notice: Feds are a class of contracts in the Inverse Finance ecosystem responsible for minting and burning DOLA. This specific Fed can expand DOLA supply into markets and contract DOLA supply from markets.
